name: OpenCode Native Queue + Ambient Session Status
description: Generation 2.x: every ordinary follow-up is admitted through the native OpenCode V2 scheduler (client.v2.session.prompt, delivery:'queue'; explicit steer only via delivery:'steer'), abort maps onto v2.session.interrupt, hydration projects native messages into the legacy transcript shape and the native event stream is projected live into the transcript stores, a projection-only ambient tint (NEUTRAL/RUNNING/NEEDS_HUMAN/DONE) is expressed by switching between background-tinted theme variants, and the authoritative completion sound (T-162) plays exactly once per completed queue drain from patch-owned staged WAV assets. No custom scheduler, no legacy/native mixed runner, no local FIFO, no timers. 2.1.0 fixes the TUI module install seam: 1.18.29 loads TUI plugins only from the tui.json 'plugin' array, never from the server-scanned plugins/ directory. 2.2.0: live transcript rows carry the complete legacy tokens shape (the 1.18.29 status bar reads tokens.output unguarded); completion sound added with settings GUI outside the OpenCode install. 2.3.0 (T-144 PATCHED_BUSY_ENTER_NO_STALL repair): on the recorded 1.18.29 build the installer ALSO applies a fail-closed, length-preserving, exactly-once-anchored binary seam (guarded globalThis.__SPB call at the single TUI dispatch point) so native session.next.* transcript events reach the visible store — the plugin-only configuration was proven to render zero assistant rows on the real host (LIVE_PROJECTION_SEAM_UNSUPPORTED). 2.4.0 (T-144 P0 LIVE FREEZE repair): package closure repaired -- saipatch-attention.js and the non-ESM runtime helper saipatch-attention-flash.ps1 are transaction-owned runtime files (the missing attention module broke the installed ESM import and left the host hook uninstalled); the host seam is fail-open -- hook absent now dispatches the ORIGINAL H(w.payload,{directory,workspace}) instead of dropping the event, with the exact original callback context for both passthrough and projected synthetic events. 2.5.1 (T-144 production occupancy fix): auto-cc queue precedence now reads an AUTHORITATIVE pending-ordinary-user-prompt tracker keyed by stable native message IDs (admission -> pending, native promotion -> consumed, bounded promotion tombstones cover the promotion-before-admission race), so user work queued BEFORE a timeout suppresses the synthetic cc; adds a DEBUG-only sanitized step.failed event-evidence sink (SAIPATCH_AUTOCC_EVENT_SINK: code/name/timeout/match only, never text). 2.5.2 (T-144 settle + intent-race repair): admissionIntents lifecycle wired into production queue core so ordinary in-flight admissions count as pending user work before native admission returns; synthetic cc explicitly identified via internal __saipatchAutoContinue (consumed by wrapper, never sent to native payload); removal of session-level synthetic admission guessing; settle-before-grace active-step accounting; bounded active-generation ownership state.

host.loadRef: tui.json 'plugin' array gains exactly one file:// entry for the module (existing keys and plugin entries preserved; Restore restores the original tui.json bytes)
requires: EventV2Bridge global event stream carries session.next.* and session.status
tui plugin api.theme.set accepts installed theme variants

hostPatch.kind: binary-anchor-replacement, length-preserving, exactly-once anchor, fail-closed on any guard, fail-open host dispatch (hook absent = original dispatch preserved). 2.5.0: onAdmitted referenced a block-scoped attentionEpisodes, so every prompt admission threw ReferenceError (attentionEpisodes is not defined / Failed to send prompt); the WS-ATT episode registry now lives at plugin scope.

ambient.authority: authoritative native events only; no prose parsing; visual layer never writes execution

modules.NATIVE_QUEUE_CORE: prompt admission -> client.v2.session.prompt delivery:queue (ordinary) / delivery:steer (explicit only); abort -> client.v2.session.interrupt; model/agent -> v2 session settings; zero custom scheduling
modules.AMBIENT_SESSION_STATUS: pure event projection into four theme-variant states; independent of queue logic; queue works with ambient disabled, ambient works with no queued items
modules.LIVE_TRANSCRIPT_PROJECTION: native event stream projected into the live sync stores (new rows once, updates in place, parts by stable identity); hydration through the wrapped client.session.messages stays authoritative; three unverified live inserts fail the seam closed
